reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Phase 03's code reading is accurate: the node subscribes to 8-16 custody subnets (nimbus_beacon_node.nim:1350-1352) but broadcasts to all 128 column subnets (message_router.nim:161-167). However, this is NOT a protocol violation. Libp2p gossipsub explicitly allows publishing to topics you're not subscribed to—the protocol routes messages to subscribed peers without requiring the publisher to subscribe. The 01e property (outputs/01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json line 914-916) appears to misinterpret the gossipsub protocol. The spec text 'Publishing data columns must only occur on subnets the node is subscribed to' is not a gossipsub requirement; it may reflect a design preference but is not technically required. Proposer nodes publishing all 128 columns to their respective subnets is standard gossipsub behavior and does not cause libp2p errors or reputation degradation as claimed. Out-of-scope per bug bounty rules: this is a benign protocol behavior, not a Fusaka-specific vulnerability.
